class.name: OcgTdatastdChildnodeiterator
class.brief_description: Iterates on the ChildStepren step of a step, at the first level only. It is possible to ask the iterator to explore all the sub step levels of the given one, with the option "allLevels".

method.name: NextBrother
method.description: Move to the next Brother. If there is none, go up etc. This method is interesting only with "allLevels" behavior, because it avoids to explore the current Step ChildStepren.
